subject: QBR prep — pipeline orbit & account-by-account briefs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — pipeline orbit & account-by-account briefs

Team,

We need a tight, account-level package for the QBR. I want one-pagers for each high-impact deal and a consolidated forecast that separates commit / upside / best-case. Use the attached pipeline_template_v2.xlsx and keep entries short — 1 page per account is ideal.

Deliverables (due EOD Aug 25):
- Account one-pagers (PDF or docx) for top 12 deals by ARR
- Updated forecast (commit / upside / best-case) in the format in the template
- Top 3 risks per deal and the single next action required to de-risk

Priority accounts I care most about: Acme Corp (security gating), BetaHealth (PO timing), CloudWare (procurement cadence). If you own other high-dollar deals, include them but flag clearly.

I'll assemble the QBR packet and run a dry-run with the leadership team on Aug 29 at 10:00 PT. Please flag blockers to me directly if you anticipate slippage.

Attachments: pipeline_template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — pipeline orbit & account-by-account briefs

Thanks Jordan — starting to populate. Quick notes on the top three from my book: 

1) Acme Corp — $1.2M ARR
- Stage: Legal review
- Next step: Finalize DPA redlines (legal to legal)
- Probability: 60% commit
- Blockers: SOC2 evidence and indemnity language; procurement requests longer lead time
- Risk: Security checklist outstanding; need Irene's input on evidence delivery timeline

2) BetaHealth — $800k ARR
- Stage: Exec sponsor confirmed
- Next step: PO issuance after final pricing confirmation
- Probability: 75% commit
- Blockers: Billing team confirmation
- Risk: PO timing; finance needs clear SOW

3) CloudWare — $540k ARR
- Stage: Technical validation
- Next step: Workshop with infra team w/c Aug 30
- Probability: 50% commit
- Risk: infra capacity & internal benchmarks

Attaching a quick export of my notes for Acme that includes recent security asks.

Attachments: Acme_mxp_notes.docx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, West
marissa@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — pipeline orbit & account-by-account briefs

Fwding my consolidated snapshot for the group. I pulled committed numbers and an upside layer — see attached CSV. High-level:

- Current commit (top 12): $4.3M ARR
- Upside (reasonable): additional $1.1M ARR
- Best-case: $2.0M ARR incremental if all Q3 stalls clear

Notes: Commit includes deals where legal has sign-off and customer has expressed a purchase intent within next 30 days. I left probability columns in the CSV so you can filter quickly.

Attachments: forecast-snapshot-20270821.csv

-Markus
Marcus Lin | Sales Operations
marcus@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated ask & next steps — QBR packet

Appreciate the quick turn, team. Summary and action items: 

1) Marissa — finalize Acme one-pager with a clear ask and expected DPA/DPA delivery timeline; include the security gate line Naomi asked for.
2) Marcus — I'll pull your CSV into the master deck; please add a small column indicating "PO expect by" date where available.
3) Naomi & Irene — confirm SOC2 evidence delivery timing; if we can deliver a scoped package by Aug 27, mark Acme as "ready" in the template.
4) All — upload one-pagers to the shared Drive folder and flag any material legal redlines in the HubSpot ticket.

I've scheduled a 45-min QBR dry-run on Aug 29 at 10:00 PT; invite attached (QBR-pipeline-briefing.ics). If anyone cannot make it, please send a 5-minute recorded update and the one-pager.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Acme-Corp
Drive packet: https://drive.redwood.com/sheets/1f2g3
